rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: A comprehensive data visualization MCP server built with TypeScript and React that transforms chart configurations into interactive, accessible visualizations using Recharts. Supports bar, line, area, pie, scatter, radar, funnel, sankey, composed, and treemap charts with advanced features like multi-chart synchronization, brush filtering, reference lines/areas, custom tooltips, and legend interactions. Emphasizes accessibility with WCAG AAA compliance, screen reader support, keyboard navigation, and theme-aware styling, while providing extensive customization options for animations, colors, labels, and responsive layouts.
